column1: # The Klein date is a group date, so it is not one route per girl: each bank is a pool of lines the
# script draws from per beat, and most beats are covered by only one or two of the four.
# Beat assignment below is inferred from content (no script trace), so treat it as a best guess.
# greeting/morning: SHORT 0-1 (hyped), MAIA 0-1 (tsundere denial), FOLD 0-2 (fine / teru teru bozu),
#                   MAIA 2 ("why'd they come?"); no outfit beat for any of them (Ichigo 1-4)
# bus:              SHORT 2 ("why not take the VA?"), KOON 2 (bus/ride arrives)
# park arrival:     SHORT 3-5 (5 = reply to the "lost child" line, FOLD 3-4), MAIA 3-6
# rides/choices:    MAIA 7 (shooting ride), KOON 3-5, KOON 1 (declines, "next time")
# bento:            FOLD 5-9 (Fold makes lunch for everyone, not the girl being dated), KOON 0
#                   ("all four at once?" if the player tries to eat everyone's), SHORT 6 (food can wait)
# haunted house:    SHORT 7-12 (others bail, Short goes alone with the player, gets scared);
#                   KOON 7-8, 10 = mirror house variant (two at a time; she admires herself)
# Ferris wheel:     MAIA 8-11 ("aerial recon", screams); FOLD 16 (wants to ride); KOON 4 (photos)
# food / misc:      FOLD 10-11, 14-15; SHORT 13 (hero show, Klein are the villains), SHORT 14-16; MAIA 12
# head home:        MAIA 13, SHORT 18, KOON 14, FOLD 12, 20
# parade:           MAIA 14-18 (childhood memory, thanks), KOON 11-16, SHORT 15-19, FOLD 13, 17
# base night:       MAIA 23-24, SHORT 24-27, KOON 20-23, FOLD 22-25
# Differences from Ichigo: no outfit/morning beat; lunch is Fold's; the haunted house goes to Short
# (or Koon's mirror house); Maia gets the Ferris wheel; each girl's base-night scene is its own
# multi-line confession instead of Ichigo's single line 73.
